paper_summary: Al-12Si syntactic foams were made by vacuum infiltration of a tap-packed bed (~65%) of 1-2 mm expanded soda-lime glass particles (EGP, 0.35 g/cm3) in stainless steel moulds preheated at 200-600 C. Foams had density ~1.14 g/cm3; mould preheats >=400 C caused clamping and EGP damage, lowering stiffness, 25%-strain crush strength and energy absorption but removing the yield load drop and raising energy absorption efficiency (84-88%). Liquid-nitrogen quenching of low-preheat samples produced the same effect; CTE was reduced to 17-19e-6/K for undamaged foams.

processing.particle_grade: Expanded soda-lime glass particles (EGP), OMYA, 1-2 mm, closed surface

structure.microstructure_notes: Mould preheat 600 C; condition: As-cast. EGP porosity ~80-85%, internal pores 100-200 um; >97% infiltration of bed; small un-infiltrated regions at EGP contact points. Higher preheats (>=400 C) cause mould clamping and EGP damage.

test.specimen_notes: Cylinders 32 mm dia x 40 mm long; crosshead 0.4 mm/s; stiffness from 4 load/unload cycles at 25-75% of yield; strength reported at 25% strain; Eab = energy absorbed (MJ/m3) with efficiency 88%

extraction_notes: Table 1 lists E in MPa (6.3-6.9); values are copied as printed although they seem implausibly low for an Al syntactic foam (possibly GPa) - flagged, not converted. Strength is the stress at 25% strain, not a yield/peak stress. Strain rate 0.01 /s derived from 0.4 mm/s crosshead over 40 mm specimen length. Particle volume fraction 0.65 is the stated approximate tap packing density; theoretical density 1.17 g/cm3 is the paper's estimate. Particle mean diameter left null (only range 1-2 mm given). CTE values from Table 2 (heating RT-200 C) converted from x10-6 K-1 to 1/K; CTE 13.7e-6 measured on cooling for the 200 C preheat not recorded as a separate record. The porous Al control (salt-replica, 0.96 g/cm3, E 5.3, Eab 5.1, 22.3 MPa) contains no particles and is excluded. EGP are porous expanded glass beads rather than hollow microspheres, so particle_type=other; vacuum casting mapped to pressure_infiltration. Test temperature assumed room temperature.
